sentences.text:
Xxxix Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate
(Acmm) Court At Bangalore, By Kamakshipalya Police
Station, Bangalore For The Offence Punishable Under
Section 498A, 323 And 506 Of Indian Penal Code, 1860
And Section 4 Of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961 At
Annexure A; And Etc.
 This Petition, Coming On For Admission, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

Learned counsel for the petitioner, after arguing the matter at length, seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the petition to avail of such other remedy as is available in law at the appropriate point of time.
Petition is disposed of as withdrawn with the aforesaid liberty.
